title: Window Cleaning Invoicing Software (2026): 5 Tools Compared
description: Window cleaning invoicing software compared: quotes, invoices, autopay, card fees and QuickBooks or Xero sync for 5 tools, with solo and crew costs.
h1: Window cleaning invoicing software: quotes, invoices, autopay and accounting sync
body:
Window cleaning money work happens in three places: the quote you send before the job, the invoice that goes out when the glass is done, and the books where every payment ends up. This page compares five tools on just that billing side: quoting, invoicing after each visit, automatic payments for repeat customers, card and bank fees, and QuickBooks or Xero sync, plus what each costs for a solo window cleaner and a 3-person crew. Every price and feature comes from the vendors' own pricing, window cleaning and payments pages, checked 2026-11-26. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For overall picks see best window cleaning business software; for customer records see window cleaning CRM; and for the repeat-visit calendar see window cleaning scheduling software.

Quoting window cleaning jobs

All five tools send quotes, but they differ in how much help they give with pricing panes and add-ons:

  • Jobber sends quotes customers approve online, shows estimated margin on each quote, and lets you suggest add-ons like gutter cleaning or pressure washing on the quote. Automated quote follow-ups are listed from Connect.
  • Housecall Pro's window cleaning page describes itemized estimates for panes, stories, screens, tracks and hard-water stain removal, reusable estimate templates and estimate follow-ups.
  • QuoteIQ includes standard, option, package and quick estimates, e-signatures and a price book on every plan; MapMeasure Pro and QuoteIQ Cam start on Beginner, and InstaQuote customer self-quoting on Elite.
  • Squeegee has simple quotes on Core and advanced quoting from Advanced.
  • Markate lists standard, option and package estimates and virtual estimates over video chat; proposal templates are a $10/mo add-on.

If you want customers to get an instant price on your website, ResponsiBid is a quoting tool (free Startup plan; Scaling $179/mo and Pro $229/mo) that hands booked jobs to Jobber, Housecall Pro or Markate, which then handle the invoice. To rough out a price yourself, try the job quote estimator.

Which one fits

  • Cheapest way to invoice and get paid online, solo: Jobber Core ($29/mo billed annually) or QuoteIQ Essentials ($29.99/mo). QuoteIQ Essentials also includes recurring billing and deposits.
  • Cheapest with QuickBooks included: Markate ($49.95/mo, or $45.95/mo billed yearly) lists QuickBooks integration in the base price. Jobber's QuickBooks Online sync starts at $99/mo billed annually.
  • Auto-charging repeat residential customers: Jobber (Connect and up) charges a saved card for recurring work; Squeegee collects by direct debit or card only after each job is completed.
  • Crews of 3 to 5 who want users included: Housecall Pro Essentials includes 5 users and QuickBooks Online sync; Jobber's Connect 5-user tier is the same $149/mo billed annually.
  • UK window cleaning rounds: Squeegee publishes GBP prices, GoCardless direct debit and HMRC VAT returns (Ultimate). It doesn't list QuickBooks or Xero.

faq: What is the best invoicing software for window cleaners?

It depends on what you need. Jobber Core ($29/mo billed annually) and QuoteIQ Essentials ($29.99/mo) are the cheapest ways to invoice and take online payments solo. Markate ($49.95/mo) includes QuickBooks and recurring invoices in its base price. Housecall Pro Essentials ($149/mo billed annually) includes 5 users and QuickBooks Online sync. Squeegee (from £19/mo per user + VAT) suits UK-style rounds with direct debit (prices checked 2026-11-26).
Which window cleaning software syncs with QuickBooks?

Jobber syncs one way to QuickBooks Online from its Connect plan. Housecall Pro lists QuickBooks Online sync from Essentials, and its QuickBooks page also mentions QuickBooks Desktop. QuoteIQ includes QuickBooks Online from Pro ($199.99/mo). Markate lists QuickBooks integration in its base price. Squeegee doesn't list QuickBooks or Xero; it has built-in bookkeeping instead (checked 2026-11-26).
Does any window cleaning software work with Xero?

Jobber's pricing page lists QuickBooks Online and Xero sync (the plan for Xero isn't stated). We didn't find Xero listed on the Housecall Pro, QuoteIQ, Squeegee or Markate pages we checked on 2026-11-26.
Can I charge repeat window cleaning customers automatically?

Jobber charges a client's saved card for recurring work, listed from its Connect plan. Squeegee collects by GoCardless direct debit (Core) or Stripe card (Advanced) only after the job is completed. Housecall Pro lists service plan auto-billing (Recurring Service Plans on MAX). QuoteIQ and Markate store cards on file, but their pages don't describe automatic charging (checked 2026-11-26).
What are the card processing fees?

Jobber publishes 2.9% + 30¢ for online cards, 2.7% + 30¢ for Tap to Pay and 1% for ACH. Housecall Pro publishes cards from 2.59% and 1% for bank payments. QuoteIQ (Stripe or Whop), Squeegee (GoCardless, Stripe, Square) and Markate (Square) don't publish rates on the pages we checked (2026-11-26).
Is there free invoicing software for window cleaning?

None of these five has a free plan. Jobber, Housecall Pro and Markate offer 14-day trials without a credit card, QuoteIQ has a 14-day trial that needs a card, and Squeegee advertises a 30-day free trial. ResponsiBid's free Startup plan covers quoting only; invoicing runs through a connected CRM (checked 2026-11-26).
